instruction: Add a new column header 'Total Days' in cell C1 of the spreadsheet.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to calculate maturity dates by adding loan duration to issue dates. Successfully added 'Maturity Date' header in C1, but formulas in C2 resulted in Err:522 (circular reference). Agent spent 50 turns trying various formula approaches (=A2+B2, =DATE(...)+120) but could not resolve the error for all rows.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc, click on specific cells, type text into cells (headers), enter formulas in cells. Struggles with date arithmetic formulas.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to correctly compute date arithmetic. The =A2+B2 formula caused Err:522. Model tried =DATE(2010,9,16)+120 which partially worked for one cell but could not generalize across all rows. Only C1 header and partial C2 were filled.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to just adding a column header, which the model demonstrated it can do successfully (it added 'Maturity Date' header correctly).
metadata.explanation: Task requires typing a specific header text in cell C1. Evaluator reads C1 value and checks case-insensitive string match.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell C1 from sheet 0 of the target xlsx file using openpyxl, matching the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_value').
